TSymbolDocument.RemoveLastSheet.text: Removes the last part's sheet and its objects (used when a heterogeneous symbol is given fewer parts).

TSymbolEditor.Create.text: Creates an editor bound to a library; nothing is open until NewSymbol or OpenSet.

params.ALib: the library that symbols are stored into (not owned)

TSymbolEditor.Destroy.text: Frees the editor's own copy of the symbol; the library is untouched.

TSymbolEditor.Issue.text: Appends a finding to a list of validation results.

params.Severity: 0 for an error, 1 for a warning

TSymbolEditor.CopySet.text: Makes a copy of a library set's data (parts per package, orientation, every name with reference, description, display types and fields), loading field values from the library first when a library is given. The copy has no database ids.
TSymbolEditor.CopySet.returns: the copy; the caller owns it

params.ALib: the library to read field values from, or nil

TSymbolEditor.NewSymbol.text: Starts a new symbol: one name, no pins, and either one shared drawing or (heterogeneous) one drawing per part. Replaces whatever was being edited.

params.ARef: its reference prefix, e.g. R? or U?
params.ADescription: the description shown in the library list
params.AParts: number of parts per package (at least 1)
params.AHetero: True if every part is drawn differently

TSymbolEditor.OpenSet.text: Opens an existing library symbol for editing on a private copy of its data and drawing, so the library can be re-read while editing.

params.ASet: the set to edit (from the library's list)

TSymbolEditor.Heterogeneous.text: Whether each part has its own drawing.
TSymbolEditor.Heterogeneous.returns: True for a drawing per part

TSymbolEditor.PartSheet.text: The sheet to draw a part on: that part's own sheet for a heterogeneous symbol, otherwise the one shared sheet.

TSymbolEditor.SetPartCount.text: Changes the number of parts. A heterogeneous symbol gains or loses part sheets; a shared drawing loses the pins of parts that no longer exist.

params.N: the new number of parts (at least 1)

TSymbolEditor.AddPin.text: Adds a pin to a part: its connection point, name, number, direction, length and shape (0 normal, 1 dot, 2 clock, 3 dot and clock, 4 power, 5 hidden). Name and number are shown. On a shared drawing the pin is tagged with its part.

params.At: the pin's connection point, in internal units

TSymbolEditor.PinCount.text: Number of pins in a part.

TSymbolEditor.AddAlias.text: Adds another name for the same drawing (an alias, e.g. the 74HC00 for a 7400); it starts with the first name's extra fields.

TSymbolEditor.RemoveAlias.text: Removes one name. The last remaining name cannot be removed.

TSymbolEditor.SetField.text: Sets an extra field (such as Footprint) of one name, adding it if it is not there; field names are matched ignoring case.

TSymbolEditor.Validate.text: Checks the symbol for mistakes. Errors: an empty or repeated name, a pin in a part the symbol does not have, two pins on the same spot. Warnings: no reference prefix, a pin with no number, a pin off the grid, a repeated pin number (power pins excepted), a part without pins, no pins at all.
TSymbolEditor.Validate.returns: the findings; empty when all is well

TSymbolEditor.Save.text: Stores the symbol in the library, replacing the symbol it was opened from (its old drawing, names and fields are removed), and returns its new id. The editor's copy is unaffected by the library re-reading itself.
TSymbolEditor.Save.returns: the symbol's new id in the library

TSymbolEditor.CopyTo.text: Stores the symbol in another library as a new symbol.
TSymbolEditor.CopyTo.returns: the new symbol's id in that library

TSymbolEditor.DeleteFromLibrary.text: Deletes the symbol this editor was opened from, with its names and fields, from its library.

FindSetByName.text: Finds the set that has a name.

DoBuild.text: Test mode: creates a library with a two pin symbol, a four-part IC with an alias and a field, and a two-part heterogeneous op-amp, and prints their ids.

DoReopen.text: Test mode: opens a symbol in the editor and prints its parts, pin counts, names and fields.

DoEdit.text: Test mode: opens a symbol, adds a pin, changes its description, adds an alias and saves.

DoParts.text: Test mode: cuts a symbol down to two parts and saves.

DoCopyTo.text: Test mode: stores a symbol of one library into another (creating it if needed).

DoDelete.text: Test mode: deletes a symbol from a library.

DoValidate.text: Test mode: builds symbols with deliberate mistakes and prints what the check reports for each.

symedittest.pas::Show.text: Prints the check results for the symbol currently being edited.
